title.text: Safe, Modern Laguna Beach Unified School District School Bond Measure
title.source_label: Orange County Registrar of Voters: Voter Information Guide, Measure A

documents.label: Measure A: county voter guide section (PDF)

district.source_label: Orange County Registrar of Voters: Voter Information Guide, Measure A

ballot_question.text: To repair and upgrade aging classrooms, science labs, career technology and school facilities to support college/career readiness in math, science, technology, arts, engineering, and skilled trades; and fix deteriorating roofs, plumbing, and electrical systems; shall Laguna Beach Unified School District’s measure be adopted authorizing $83 million in bonds at legal rates (without increasing current tax rates), levying $8.85 per $100,000 assessed value ($5 million annually) while bonds are outstanding, with independent audits, citizen oversight, all money locally controlled?
ballot_question.source_label: Orange County Registrar of Voters: Voter Information Guide, Measure A

district.source_label: Orange County Registrar of Voters: Voter Information Guide, Measure B

ballot_question.text: To provide safe, modern schools by repairing, upgrading and equipping aging classrooms, labs, instructional technology, and school facilities to support student achievement in math, science, technology, arts and engineering, fixing deteriorated roofs, plumbing, HVAC, electrical systems and improving school safety/security systems, shall Westminster School District’s measure authorizing $128,000,000 in bonds at legal rates be adopted, levying $30 per $100,000 assessed value ($8,000,000 annually) while bonds are outstanding, with citizen oversight, independent audits, all money locally-controlled?
